message: The other night, I was cooking dinner when the smoke alarm decided it was the perfect time to go off. 😅 I was scrambling to fan the smoke away while texting my family group chat about what to do if it was a real fire. Turns out, everyone chimed in with their own fire escape plans and kitchen mishaps. It was a little chaotic, but it reminded me how important it is to have those conversations ahead of time. We all laughed it off, but I felt grateful to know we’re on the same page about safety. Have you chatted with your family about your escape plan lately?
